1.name: Deadplant
1.text: * Hello, and welcome to my [color=green]dialogue system[/color].

1.name: Deadplant
1.text:
* If you need help open my Guide file, the files
	 you need to move to your own project are in
	 there.

1.name: Deadplant
1.text:
* But if you just want the basic run down then
	 press "Z" to interact which can be changed
	 from the default input map and "X" to skip
	 dialouge which can be changed from the
	custom input map in the settings

1.name: Deadplant
1.text: * To run dialouge easly use the "Run_dialouge" method but besides that Enjoy!

2.name: Deadplant
2.text: * Over here is the next room with more npcs.

2.name: Deadplant
2.text: * once your over there back to the left and it will bring you right back

2.name: Deadplant
2.text: * Also this is how you use dialouge for cutscenes... Enjoy!

3.name: Deadplant
3.text: * The npc's work of of an instance system.

3.name: Deadplant
3.text:
* It helps with moving between scences
	and removing npcs depending on your choices.

3.name: Deadplant
3.text: * The npc always goes to the next availible instance.

3.name: Deadplant
3.text:
* when all of its intances have
	passed/not availible it's deleted.

3.name: Deadplant
3.text:
* you can also connect dialogue signals
	to custom methods in the npc to change the instcne or animate cutcene.
